mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aftersale_command(id,command_namespace,actor_type,actor_id,scope,request_id,payload_sha256,canonical_version,canonical_bytes,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{namespace},#{actorType},#{actor},#{scope},#{requestId},#{hash},'canonical-v1',#{canonical},'RESERVED',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM aftersale_command WHERE command_namespace=#{namespace} AND actor_type=#{actorType} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND scope=#{scope} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE aftersale_command SET state='SUCCEEDED',result_version=1,result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM aftersale_case WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM aftersale_case ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM aftersale_case WHERE order_id=#{order} AND active_flag=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM aftersale_case WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status='RESOLVED' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND decision_type IN ('REJECT','RESERVICE','OTHER') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE aftersale_case SET status=#{to},active_flag=#{active},version=version+1,current_supplement_id=#{supplement,jdbcType=BIGINT},decision_id=#{decision,jdbcType=BIGINT},refund_order_id=#{refund,jdbcType=BIGINT},duplicate_final_case_id=#{duplicate,jdbcType=BIGINT},decision_type=#{decisionType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},decision_amount=#{decisionAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL},accepted_at=CASE WHEN #{action}='ACCEPTED' THEN #{at} ELSE accepted_at END,resolved_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='RESOLVED' THEN #{at} ELSE resolved_at END,closed_at=CASE WHEN #{to} IN ('CLOSED','WITHDRAWN') THEN #{at} ELSE closed_at END WHERE id=#{case} AND version=#{oldVersion} AND status=#{from} AND active_flag=1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aftersale_transition WHERE aftersale_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY case_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM aftersale_evidence_batch WHERE aftersale_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM aftersale_evidence_asset WHERE batch_id=#{batch} ORDER BY asset_id
SELECT * FROM aftersale_supplement WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM aftersale_supplement WHERE aftersale_id=#{caseId} AND status='OPEN' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE aftersale_supplement SET status=#{status},closed_at=#{at},completion_command_id=#{command} WHERE id=#{supplement} AND aftersale_id=#{case} AND status='OPEN'

UPDATE aftersale_decision SET refund_order_id=#{refund},refund_no=#{refundNo},refund_created_event_id=#{event},refund_created_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{decision} AND aftersale_id=#{case} AND refund_order_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aftersale_supplement WHERE id>#{after} AND status='OPEN' AND deadline<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aftersale_recovery_issue(supplement_id,issue_code,aftersale_id,store_id,status,occurrences,created_at,last_seen_at) VALUES(#{supplement},#{code},#{caseId},#{store},'OPEN',1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='OPEN',occurrences=occurrences+1,last_seen_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),resolved_at=NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE aftersale_recovery_issue SET status='RESOLVED',resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE supplement_id=#{supplement} AND status='OPEN'
